handoffs.message: Helper-claimed by Codex2 while Codex completes higher-priority work.

Rebaselined backlog/SA/inventory truth for already-live route families. WORKBENCH_DELIVERY_BACKLOG now marks EW-04 as route-live with active handoff, TW-03 as route-live with handoff activation pending, and TW-04 as route-live with handoff ready. PANTHEON_FRONTEND_SA now moves RW-04 and TW-04 into formal route-live pages, keeps TW-03 as live-but-not-yet-handoff-ready, and updates route-live expansion / blocked-module guidance. The 2026-04-20 progress inventory now reflects RW-04 and TW-04 as frontend-ready while leaving TW-03 as the remaining trainer handoff activation gap.
Review approved: backlog, frontend SA, and progress inventory now align on live route truth; owner should finalize this task to done after any last record sync.
